finding.value_type: The unchanged public CSS SHA256 previously independently verified in unify-stage1-secret-evidence.json

cause: Adding the mobile.css entry adds a trailing JSON comma to the preceding checksum line, so full-history scanning sees the unchanged checksum in a new commit.
handling: Only the exact commit/file/rule/line fingerprint is excepted; all future values and commits remain scanned. No rule or directory allowlist is added.
